written: 2026-11-18, after the calibration gate (main_calib) and before the main run (main_main, main_probe, main_sens, main_held, spot) was flown

inputs.people: internal_4 with YEGO's four runs (ERKS, ALEX, SIMI, YEGO; 18 runs, 54 correct presses)
inputs.image: the whole frame (the recorder's rule since 2026-11-18), not its central 80%
inputs.resolution: hazards fitted on pixel-equivalent distance at the trials' feeds (1920 x 1080 on 60 deg screens: 17.75 px per world degree); the 360 drone shows the 2K live stream (2048 x 1024: 5.69 px/deg), so its distances count x3.12; SIMI's cube (22 px/deg) x0.81
inputs.recognition: press-credited (`pooled`) primary, chosen by the gate below; first-sight credit (`start`) beside it
inputs.noticing: crowd-noticing hazard with its steepness fixed at k 8 (the likelihood is flat in k); walkers drawn to 500 m
inputs.flying: the swarm wraps each goal building; one drone as internal_4's pilots flew it; the 360 drone flies the single drone's searches at its altitudes (a camera swap); altitudes and pitches the median over pilots of each pilot's median

gate.flown_as: the people flew: swarm circling the block (and wrapped, reported beside), one drone, the sphere as SIMI flew it (own style, own altitudes, the cube)
gate.checks: per condition, the geometric-mean time at the goal and between goals inside internal_4's 95% bootstrap intervals (resampling runs); the swarm's at-goal ratios to one drone and to the sphere inside theirs; 8 checks
gate.use: the recognition credit that passes most checks is reported as the better calibrated; the main run carries both credits whatever the gate says (lesson 38's named fallback: the gaps are reported, not tuned away)
gate.result: main_calib (all 240 sessions), read before the main run: press-credited passes 5 of 8, wrapped and circling alike, failing the sphere at the goal (48 s against 28-45), the sphere between goals (69 s against 32-36, an interval on SIMI's 2 runs) and the swarm between goals (72-75 s against 50-71, just outside); first sight passes 3 of 8, faster than the people at the goal (swarm 28-29 s against 31-51, one drone 52 against 55-115) and slower between goals. Every variant is slower than the people between goals. So the verdict is read on press-credited recognition. (A first reading at 234 of 240 sessions said 6 of 8 wrapped.)

verdict.measure: task time, start line to the third press, restricted mean to the 900 s cap, paired over the 300 sessions of the trial city (k 1000-1299), 95% bootstrap over sessions, press-credited recognition (first sight beside it)
verdict.swarm_vs_360: swarm / 360 drone: interval wholly below 0.9 -> the swarm is at least 10% faster; wholly above 1/0.9 -> the 360 drone is; wholly inside [0.9, 1/0.9] -> equivalent within 10%; otherwise undecided at this size
verdict.beside: the first-sight variant, the held-out cities (per city, never pooled), the sensitivities; the probe's view decomposition (wrapped swarm's views / a 360 camera on its most central drone, at the sphere's and at the swarm's altitude) is reported, not tested

spot_check.run: spot (12 routes per condition, k 1400-1411), Unity's headless bench and the replica twin from Unity's start
spot_check.agrees_if: the median route time within 10%, the swarm's median wrapped share within 0.10, and Unity's drone losses inside the exact 95% Poisson interval of the twins' (and the reverse)

replays: views_replays.py: typical (swarm / 360 ratio nearest the median), swarm's best, 360 drone's best, the most drones lost; each re-flown with a tape and kept only if it re-flies as stored
